title: Eastern US recovers from storms that snarled Thanksgiving travel as flooding continues
summary_full: Heavy rains and high winds downed trees and power lines and led to water rescues from New York to VirginiaSkies are clearing along the US eastern seaboard, and power was being restored to hundreds of thousands of customers, whose Thanksgiving plans were disrupted by heavy rains and high winds that swept over the region on Thursday.The storms snarled travel, downed trees and power lines and led to water rescues from New York to Virginia. At its peak, nearly a million customers were without power and widespread coastal flooding was reported by Poweroutage.us. Continue reading...
